about: What the shipped files may hold that the hygiene scan reports: each entry is one file, one kind of finding and one purpose, with the exact literals it covers. A literal allowed in one file is not allowed in any other, and an entry for a name in text does not cover the same name held against a page or an address. Reviewed by hand; tests/unit/hygiene-hosts.test.js fails on any finding no entry covers, and on any listed literal nothing uses.

files.why: The Public Suffix List itself, generated by scripts/update-public-suffixes.mjs. The test checks it holds the list and nothing else.
